verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Sandboxes documents its own point-in-time directory snapshots to R2 with later restore, plus R2/S3 bucket mounts for data that persists across sandbox lifecycles. That covers the filesystem side of resuming work, but nothing shows a pause/resume operation or preservation of in-memory process state, and a community member notes it is unclear how filesystem persistence works when a container goes idle. missing for 10: an explicit pause/resume API, memory/process-state preservation, whole-sandbox (not per-directory) snapshots, hands-on corroboration.
